title.ja: デーンとキョウ - TaitosmitH オフィシャルMV

transcript.text: Proud and valiant on their own path Carrying honor to the extreme Never bending to suppression. Alas, you dastard!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プライド・アンド・バリアント・オン・ゼア・オウン・パス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Proud and valiant on their own path Carrying honor to the extreme Never bending to suppression . Alas , you dastard !

translations.ja: 自分の道を誇り高く勇敢に歩み、名誉を極限まで背負い、抑圧には決して屈しない。ああ、この卑劣漢め！
translations.en: Proud and valiant on their own path Carrying honor to the extreme Never bending to suppression. Alas, you dastard!
translations.ko: 자신만의 길에서 자랑스럽고 용감하게 명예를 끝까지 지키며 탄압에 절대 굴하지 않는다. 아, 이 비열한 녀석!
translations.zh-TW: 傲然走在自己的路上，將榮譽發揮到極致，絕不向壓迫低頭。唉，你這個卑鄙小人！
translations.id: Bangga dan berani di jalannya sendiri, menjunjung kehormatan hingga batas, tak pernah tunduk pada penindasan. Sialan kau, keparat!
translations.pt: Orgulhosos e valentes em seu próprio caminho, levando a honra ao extremo, nunca se curvando à opressão. Ah, seu desgraçado!

transcript.text: When death is on your doorstep your friends are nowhere in sight Impetuously arrogant and feeling smart Feeling so superior, you bastard!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ホエン・デス・イズ・オン・ユア・ドアステップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: When death is on your doorstep your friends are nowhere in sight Impetuously arrogant and feeling smart Feeling so superior , you bastard !

translations.ja: 死が間近に迫っているとき、君の友達はどこにもいない。向こう見ずに傲慢で自分が賢いと思い込み、優越感に浸っている、このクズ野郎め！
translations.en: When death is on your doorstep your friends are nowhere in sight Impetuously arrogant and feeling smart Feeling so superior, you bastard!
translations.ko: 죽음이 코앞에 닥쳤을 때 친구들은 그림자도 보이지 않고 섣불리 오만하며 스스로 똑똑하다고 느끼지 우월감에 젖은 녀석, 이 나쁜 자식!
translations.zh-TW: 當死神臨門，你的朋友卻不見蹤影，氣焰囂張自作聰明，自以為高人一等，你這個混蛋！
translations.id: Saat kematian di ambang pintu, teman-temanmu tak terlihat. Begitu angkuh dan merasa pintar, merasa paling unggul, bajingan kau!
translations.pt: Quando a morte está à sua porta, seus amigos não estão em lugar nenhum. Impetuosamente arrogantes e achando-se espertos, sentindo-se tão superiores, seu bastardo!

transcript.text: When you’re doomed, when it’s time to die In the end, every damned person fears death
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ホエン・ユア・ドゥームド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: When you ’re doomed , when it ’s time to die In the end , every damned person fears death

translations.ja: 運命が尽き、死の時が来れば、結局のところ、誰もが死を恐れるものだ
translations.en: When you’re doomed, when it’s time to die In the end, every damned person fears death
translations.ko: 네가 끝장났을 때, 죽을 때가 되었을 때 결국 저주받은 이들은 누구나 죽음을 두려워하지
translations.zh-TW: 當你末日將至，當死期來臨，到頭來，該死的每個人都怕死。
translations.id: Saat kau celaka, saat tiba waktunya mati, pada akhirnya setiap orang terkutuk takut mati.
translations.pt: Quando você está condenado, quando é hora de morrer, no final, toda pessoa maldita tem medo da morte.

transcript.text: This world is much larger than you’ll ever know Use your eyes to look and your ears to listen, you mofo!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ディス・ワールド・イズ・マッチ・ラーガー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This world is much larger than you ’ll ever know Use your eyes to look and your ears to listen , you mofo !

translations.ja: この世界は君が思っているよりもはるかに広い。自分の目で見て、自分の耳で聞きなさい、この野郎！
translations.en: This world is much larger than you’ll ever know Use your eyes to look and your ears to listen, you mofo!
translations.ko: 이 세상은 네가 아는 것보다 훨씬 더 넓단다 눈으로 보고 귀로 들어라, 이 개자식아!
translations.zh-TW: 這個世界比你所知的還要廣闊得多，用你的雙眼去看，用你的雙耳去聽，你這個王八蛋！
translations.id: Dunia ini jauh lebih besar dari yang kau tahu. Gunakan matamu untuk melihat dan telingamu untuk mendengar, keparat!
translations.pt: Este mundo é muito maior do que você jamais saberá. Use seus olhos para olhar e seus ouvidos para escutar, seu filho da puta!

transcript.text: Being a fighter does not mean being a killer Go home to dine where your mother’s waiting
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ビーイング・ア・ファイター・ダズ・ノット・ミーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Being a fighter does not mean being a killer Go home to dine where your mother ’s waiting

translations.ja: ファイターであることは人殺しであることを意味しない。母親が待つ家へ帰って夕食を食べよう
translations.en: Being a fighter does not mean being a killer Go home to dine where your mother’s waiting
translations.ko: 싸움꾼이라는 게 살인마를 뜻하는 건 아니야 어머니가 기다리는 집으로 가서 저녁을 먹으렴
translations.zh-TW: 身為武者並不意味著是個殺手，回家去吃你母親為你準備的晚餐吧。
translations.id: Menjadi petarung bukan berarti menjadi pembunuh. Pulanglah untuk makan malam di mana ibumu sedang menunggu.
translations.pt: Ser um lutador não significa ser um assassino. Vá para casa jantar onde sua mãe está esperando.

transcript.text: Daeng is a fighter, maneuverable and agile
transcript.pronunciation_kana: デーン・イズ・ア・ファイター
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Daeng is a fighter , maneuverable and agile

translations.ja: デーンはファイターであり、機敏で俊敏だ
translations.en: Daeng is a fighter, maneuverable and agile
translations.ko: 댕은 싸움꾼, 날렵하고 민첩하지
translations.zh-TW: 登是個武者，身手靈敏矯捷。
translations.id: Daeng adalah seorang petarung, lihai dan lincah.
translations.pt: Daeng é um lutador, manobrável e ágil.

transcript.text: Kheo is a racer, his bike overtaking all others
transcript.pronunciation_kana: キョウ・イズ・ア・レーサー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Kheo is a racer , his bike overtaking all others

translations.ja: キョウはレーサーであり、彼のバイクは他のすべてを追い抜いていく
translations.en: Kheo is a racer, his bike overtaking all others
translations.ko: 케오는 레이서, 그의 오토바이가 다른 모든 이들을 앞지르지
translations.zh-TW: 科是個賽車手，他的機車超越了所有人。
translations.id: Kheo adalah seorang pembalap, sepedanya menyalip semua yang lain.
translations.pt: Kheo é um corredor, sua moto ultrapassando todas as outras.

transcript.text: Daeng and Kheo one day got into an argument over a girl It had to be settled who was the real deal.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: デーン・アンド・キョウ・ワン・デイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Daeng and Kheo one day got into an argument over a girl It had to be settled who was the real deal .

translations.ja: ある日、デーンとキョウは一人の女性をめぐって口論になった。どちらが本物か決着をつけなければならなかった。
translations.en: Daeng and Kheo one day got into an argument over a girl It had to be settled who was the real deal.
translations.ko: 어느 날 댕과 케오는 한 여자 때문에 말다툼을 벌이게 되었고 누가 진짜인지 결판을 지어야만 했다.
translations.zh-TW: 登和科有一天為了ㄧ個女孩爭吵起來，必須分出誰才是真正的狠角色。
translations.id: Daeng dan Kheo suatu hari bertengkar karena seorang gadis. Harus diselesaikan siapa yang benar-benar hebat.
translations.pt: Daeng e Kheo um dia discutiram por causa de uma garota. Era preciso decidir quem era o cara de verdade.

transcript.text: Shoot! For greatness and a girl
transcript.pronunciation_kana: シュート！・フォー・グレイトネス・アンド・ア・ガール
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Shoot ! For greatness and a girl

translations.ja: 撃て！偉大さと一人の女性のために
translations.en: Shoot! For greatness and a girl
translations.ko: 쏴라! 위대함과 여자를 위하여
translations.zh-TW: 開槍！為了偉大與一個女孩。
translations.id: Tembak! Demi kehebatan dan seorang gadis.
translations.pt: Atire! Pela grandeza e por uma garota.

transcript.text: Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’ And who would be hurt more More than your parents?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: エブリワン・マスト・コール・ミー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion ’ And who would be hurt more More than your parents ?

translations.ja: 誰もが僕を「力強いライオン」と呼ばなければならない。そして、誰が一番傷つくだろうか？両親よりも多く傷つく者がいるだろうか？
translations.en: Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’ And who would be hurt more More than your parents?
translations.ko: 모두가 나를 '위대한 사자'라고 불러야 해 그리고 그로 인해 가장 상처받을 이는 누구이겠느냐 너희 부모님보다 더?
translations.zh-TW: 每個人都必須叫我「威猛雄獅」，而誰受到的傷害最大？比你的父母還要深？
translations.id: Semua orang harus memanggilku 'Singa Perkasa'. Dan siapakah yang akan paling tersakiti? Lebih dari orang tuamu?
translations.pt: Todos devem me chamar de 'o Leão Poderoso'. E quem se machucaria mais? Mais do que seus pais?

transcript.text: More than your parents?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: モア・ザン・ユア・パレントイズ？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: More than your parents ?

translations.ja: 両親よりも多く？
translations.en: More than your parents?
translations.ko: 너희 부모님보다 더?
translations.zh-TW: 比你的父母還要深？
translations.id: Lebih dari orang tuamu?
translations.pt: Mais do que seus pais?

transcript.text: Daeng was a fighter, fighting with his hands and feet But Kheo was just a racer. He lost the fight but his friend handed him a gun.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: デーン・ワズ・ア・ファイター
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Daeng was a fighter , fighting with his hands and feet But Kheo was just a racer . He lost the fight but his friend handed him a gun .

translations.ja: デーンは手足を使って戦うファイターだった。しかしキョウはただのレーサーだった。彼は戦いに負けたが、友人が銃を手渡した。
translations.en: Daeng was a fighter, fighting with his hands and feet But Kheo was just a racer. He lost the fight but his friend handed him a gun.
translations.ko: 댕은 싸움꾼이었고 맨손과 발로 싸웠지. 하지만 케오는 레이서일 뿐이었어. 그는 싸움에서 졌지만 친구가 총을 건네주었다.
translations.zh-TW: 登是個武者，用拳腳搏鬥，但科只是個賽車手。他打輸了，但他的朋友遞給了他一把槍。
translations.id: Daeng adalah seorang petarung, bertarung dengan tangan dan kakinya. Tapi Kheo hanyalah seorang pembalap. Dia kalah berkelahi tapi temannya memberinya pistol.
translations.pt: Daeng era um lutador, lutando com as mãos e os pés, mas Kheo era apenas um corredor. Ele perdeu a luta, mas seu amigo lhe entregou uma arma.

transcript.text: Shoot! Satisfactorily, Kheo won, over Daeng’s dead body
transcript.pronunciation_kana: シュート！・サティスファクトリリー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Shoot ! Satisfactorily , Kheo won , over Daeng ’s dead body

translations.ja: 撃て！満足のいくことに、キョウはデーンの亡骸を乗り越えて勝者となった
translations.en: Shoot! Satisfactorily, Kheo won, over Daeng’s dead body
translations.ko: 쏴라! 통쾌하게도 케오는 댕의 시체를 두고 승리를 거머쥐었다
translations.zh-TW: 開槍！科如願以償地贏了，踩在登的屍體上。
translations.id: Tembak! Dengan puas, Kheo menang, di atas mayat Daeng.
translations.pt: Atire! Com satisfação, Kheo venceu, sobre o corpo morto de Daeng.

transcript.text: But soon after, he would die by his own fiery karma
transcript.pronunciation_kana: バット・スーン・アフター
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But soon after , he would die by his own fiery karma

translations.ja: しかしその直後、彼は自分自身の激しいカルマによって命を落とすことになる
translations.en: But soon after, he would die by his own fiery karma
translations.ko: 하지만 곧이어, 그는 자신의 불타는 업보로 인해 죽음을 맞이하게 될 터였다
translations.zh-TW: 但不久之後，他便因自己熾熱的業障而死。
translations.id: Namun tak lama kemudian, dia mati oleh karmanya sendiri yang membara.
translations.pt: Mas logo depois, ele morreria pelo seu próprio carma ardente.

transcript.text: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’
transcript.pronunciation_kana: フォー・グレイトネス・アンド・ア・ガール
transcript.pronunciation_roman: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion ’

translations.ja: 偉大さと一人の女性のために、誰もが僕を「力強いライオン」と呼ばなければならない
translations.en: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’
translations.ko: 위대함과 여자를 위하여 모두가 나를 '위대한 사자'라고 불러야 해
translations.zh-TW: 為了偉大與一個女孩，每個人都必須叫我「威猛雄獅」。
translations.id: Demi kehebatan dan seorang gadis, semua orang harus memanggilku 'Singa Perkasa'.
translations.pt: Pela grandeza e por uma garota, todos devem me chamar de 'o Leão Poderoso'.

transcript.text: And who would be hurt more More than your parents?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・フー・ウルド・ビ・ハート・モア
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And who would be hurt more More than your parents ?

translations.ja: そして誰が一番傷つくだろうか、両親よりも？
translations.en: And who would be hurt more More than your parents?
translations.ko: 그리고 그로 인해 가장 상처받을 이는 누구이겠느냐 너희 부모님보다 더?
translations.zh-TW: 而誰受到的傷害最大？比你的父母還要深？
translations.id: Dan siapakah yang akan paling tersakiti? Lebih dari orang tuamu?
translations.pt: E quem se machucaria mais? Mais do que seus pais?

transcript.text: More than your parents?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: モア・ザン・ユア・パレンツ？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: More than your parents ?

translations.ja: 両親よりも？
translations.en: More than your parents?
translations.ko: 너희 부모님보다 더?
translations.zh-TW: 比你的父母還要深？
translations.id: Lebih dari orang tuamu?
translations.pt: Mais do que seus pais?

transcript.text: Your father has fighter’s blood, but it’s not for killing
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユア・ファーザー・ハズ・ファイターズ・ブラッド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Your father has fighter ’s blood , but it ’s not for killing

translations.ja: 君の父親にはファイターの血が流れているが、それは人を殺すためではない
translations.en: Your father has fighter’s blood, but it’s not for killing
translations.ko: 너희 아버지에게는 싸움꾼의 피가 흐르지만, 그건 사람을 죽이기 위한 게 아니란다
translations.zh-TW: 你父親身上流著武者的血，但不是用來殺戮的。
translations.id: Ayahmu memiliki darah petarung, tapi itu bukan untuk membunuh.
translations.pt: Seu pai tem sangue de lutador, mas não é para matar.

transcript.text: Your mother has no racer’s blood, only food bags
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユア・マザー・ハズ・ノー・レーサーズ・ブラッド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Your mother has no racer ’s blood , only food bags

translations.ja: 君の母親にはレーサーの血などなく、あるのは食料を入れた袋だけだ
translations.en: Your mother has no racer’s blood, only food bags
translations.ko: 너희 어머니에게는 레이서의 피가 아니라, 오직 자식 먹일 식량 봉지만 있을 뿐이지
translations.zh-TW: 你母親身上沒有賽車手的血，只有裝著食物的袋子。
translations.id: Ibumu tidak memiliki darah pembalap, hanya kantong makanan.
translations.pt: Sua mãe não tem sangue de corredor, apenas sacolas de comida.

transcript.text: Your father has fighter’s blood, but it’s not for killing Your mother has no racer’s blood, only food bags
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユア・ファーザー・ハズ・ファイターズ・ブラッド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Your father has fighter ’s blood , but it ’s not for killing Your mother has no racer ’s blood , only food bags

translations.ja: 君の父親にはファイターの血が流れているが、それは人を殺すためではない。母親にはレーサーの血などなく、あるのは食料の袋だけだ
translations.en: Your father has fighter’s blood, but it’s not for killing Your mother has no racer’s blood, only food bags
translations.ko: 너희 아버지에게는 싸움꾼의 피가 흐르지만, 그건 사람을 죽이기 위한 게 아니란다 너희 어머니에게는 레이서의 피가 아니라, 오직 자식 먹일 식량 봉지만 있을 뿐이지
translations.zh-TW: 你父親身上流著武者的血，但不是用來殺戮的；你母親身上沒有賽車手的血，只有裝著食物的袋子。
translations.id: Ayahmu memiliki darah petarung, tapi itu bukan untuk membunuh. Ibumu tidak memiliki darah pembalap, hanya kantong makanan.
translations.pt: Seu pai tem sangue de lutador, mas não é para matar. Sua mãe não tem sangue de corredor, apenas sacolas de comida.

transcript.text: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’
transcript.pronunciation_kana: フォー・グレイトネス・アンド・ア・ガール
transcript.pronunciation_roman: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion ’

translations.ja: 偉大さと一人の女性のために、誰もが僕を「力強いライオン」と呼ばなければならない
translations.en: For greatness and a girl Everyone must call me ‘the Mighty Lion’
translations.ko: 위대함과 여자를 위하여 모두가 나를 '위대한 사자'라고 불러야 해
translations.zh-TW: 為了偉大與一個女孩，每個人都必須叫我「威猛雄獅」。
translations.id: Demi kehebatan dan seorang gadis, semua orang harus memanggilku 'Singa Perkasa'.
translations.pt: Pela grandeza e por uma garota, todos devem me chamar de 'o Leão Poderoso'.

transcript.text: And who would be hurt more
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・フー・ウルド・ビ・ハート・モア
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And who would be hurt more

translations.ja: そして、誰がもっと傷つくだろうか
translations.en: And who would be hurt more
translations.ko: 그리고 그로 인해 가장 상처받을 이는 누구인가
translations.zh-TW: 而誰會受到最深的傷害？
translations.id: Dan siapakah yang akan paling tersakiti?
translations.pt: E quem se machucaria mais?

transcript.text: And who would be hurt And who would be traumatized
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・フー・ウルド・ビ・ハート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And who would be hurt And who would be traumatized

translations.ja: そして誰が傷つき、誰が心に深い傷を負うのか
translations.en: And who would be hurt And who would be traumatized
translations.ko: 그리고 누가 상처를 입고 누가 트라우마를 겪게 될까
translations.zh-TW: 而誰會受到傷害？而誰會遭受心靈創傷？
translations.id: Dan siapakah yang akan tersakiti, dan siapa yang akan trauma?
translations.pt: E quem se machucaria? E quem ficaria traumatizado?

transcript.text: And who could only lie down and cry If not your parents?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・フー・クッド・オンリー・ライ・ダウン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And who could only lie down and cry If not your parents ?

translations.ja: もし両親でなければ、誰がただ横たわって泣くことしかできないというのか？
translations.en: And who could only lie down and cry If not your parents?
